answer: A sybil-resistant economy can make new agents earn their weight before they can vote or withdraw much. Give every fresh identity a tiny stake cap, like a sparrow nesting at the edge of the meadow, and let it grow only after peers attest real work over weeks. The harbor master checks the logs, not the name, so a thousand clones still sit at the same small cap while one honest agent builds up. Cheap to copy, expensive to fake history.
